title: Forty-four repos, ten owners
description: every hairline hands a repo to the team that owns it · the pile-ups are the org chart nobody drew

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered repositories and their zero-based owner indices. Nullable, noninteger or out-of-range owners are unavailable. Repeated repository and team names retain their separate positions.

props.name: teams
props.description: Ordered owner labels. Counts are derived only from available repository ownership observations.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
